source: consents.Consent for TG consent type 'billing_company_stamp', keyed on a SigningIdentity whose identity is accounts_account.number
transformation: '1' when the latest consent value is ACCEPTED, else '0'. String, never null.

source: payments_paymentinstruction.reference, billing_control_number token of the TGPS InstructionReference
transformation: Reference string is tokenised and the billing_control_number token (validated to start with '9') is emitted as-is.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_tgpaymentreferences.serial_number when the feature flag is on; otherwise count of payments_accountpayment rows on the ledger up to this payment plus constant 20000
transformation: Passthrough string from KonbiniBarcode.serial_number.

ja_label: コンビニ払込用バーコード
source: Assembled from constants GS1_APPLICATION_CODE '91' and GS1_COMPANY_INVOICING_CODE '920907', billing_control_number, serial number, charge occurrence date, issuing counter, constant '999999', stamp flag and payments_accountpayment.amount
transformation: '5' + '2' + '91' + '920907' + control no + serial + last digit of year + MMDD + counter + '999999' + stamp flag + amount.zfill(6) + check digit 1 + check digit 2 + '6'.

ja_label: バーコード_チェックデジット
source: Computed from the barcode payload (no database origin)
transformation: First check digit only (modulus-10 weighted 3:1 over the payload).

source: Hardcoded GS1_APPLICATION_CODE wrapped in parentheses
transformation: Constant '(91)'.

source: Constants '00190000072' and '200000000000000' plus payments_accountpayment.amount
transformation: '00190000072' + amount.zfill(11) + '200000000000000', prefixed with two computed OCR check digits.

source: billing_control_number from payments_paymentinstruction.reference, charge occurrence date, payments_accountpayment.amount, payment slip serial number, plus constants '000' / '00' / '56658'
transformation: '000' + control no + charge occurrence date + '00' + amount.zfill(11) + serial + '56658', prefixed with two computed OCR check digits.

source: Hardcoded in the barcode builder (no database origin)
transformation: Constant '999999'. Not the bill due date.

source: Hardcoded GS1_COMPANY_INVOICING_CODE
transformation: Constant '920907'.

source: Count of cashflow_tg_payments_accountpaymentmessage rows for the payment whose comms_message.template_code is the legacy 'KONBINI-PAYMENT-SCHEDULED' and which are not errored
transformation: str(count). Values outside 0-9 raise CouldNotGenerateBarcode.

source: payments_accountpayment.amount compared against the hardcoded 50000 threshold
transformation: '1' when amount >= 50000 else '0'.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.postal_code, reached from payments_paymentinstruction.reference via cashflow_tg_payments_paymentslippaymentinstruction.payer
transformation: Passthrough, hyphen retained.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.address_code
transformation: zfill(11).

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.chome
transformation: Passthrough.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.banchi
transformation: Passthrough.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.go
transformation: Passthrough.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.edaban
transformation: Passthrough.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.building_number
transformation: Passthrough.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.room_number
transformation: Passthrough.

ja_label: 支払人_お客さま名（漢字）
source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.kanji_family_name and kanji_given_name; falls back to kana_family_name and kana_given_name when both kanji fields are empty; overridden by the payer name supplied on a payment slip re-issue
transformation: family_name + ' ' + given_name. Half-width space. No to_full_width, no honorific.

ja_label: 法人名＋支払人_お客さま名
source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.kanji_company_name plus the same name chain as billing_customer_name_kanji
transformation: to_full_width(company_name + ' ' + family_name + ' ' + given_name).

ja_label: 支払人_お客さま名（敬称付き）
source: Same name chain as billing_customer_name_kanji plus the hardcoded honorific constants.NAME_HONORIFIC = '　様' (ideographic space + 様)
transformation: to_full_width(family_name + ' ' + given_name + '　様'). Unconditional: there is no flag and no length check on this branch, unlike utils.strings.conditionally_include_name_suffix used elsewhere.

source: accounts_account.number plus constants '999A0' and KRAKEN_STANDARD_PAYMENT_SLIP_COMM_CODE = 'KRA003'
transformation: f'999A0-{account.number}-KRA003'.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.locality
transformation: locality.strip(); codes.UNSPECIFIED (' ') when empty. Deliberately not converted to full width: the code notes the length could be exceeded and TG Hub handles it.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.chome, banchi, go, edaban
transformation: get_street_address joins the populated components with '-', then .strip().

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.kanji_building_name
transformation: Taken as-is then .strip(); empty when unset.

ja_label: 郵送先_住所4（建物番号・部屋番号）
source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.building_number and room_number
transformation: get_building_and_room_number joins the populated components with ' ', then .strip().

source: No database source (codes.UNSPECIFIED)
transformation: Always the constant ' ' (single half-width space).

ja_label: 郵送先_カスタマバーコード
source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.postal_code plus the street string built from chome/banchi/go/edaban
transformation: Postcode hyphens removed, street reduced to digits, hyphens and '$' only, right-padded with '$' to 20 chars, check digit appended, wrapped in '<' and '>'.

source: Hardcoded parts plus the generation date (localtime.today())
transformation: f'000001-{today:%Y%m%d}KRNP05A001-000001#'. The sequence-number substitution used for TSV Shinsuna files is not applied here.

source: cashflow_tg_payments_addressee.physical_location_identifier
transformation: Passthrough; codes.UNSPECIFIED (' ') when null or empty.

source: addresses_address.locality on the supply point property rich_address
transformation: Passthrough; codes.UNSPECIFIED (' ') when empty.

source: addresses_address structured street address (chome, banchi, go, edaban) on the supply point property
transformation: get_street_address joins the populated components with '-'; not converted to full width.

source: addresses_address structured street address kanji_building_name
transformation: Taken as-is (default ' ' when the key is absent); not stripped, not converted to full width.

ja_label: 使用者_建物番号・部屋番号
source: addresses_address structured street address building_number and room_number
transformation: get_building_and_room_number joins the populated components with ' '.

source: Business accounts: accounts_account.billing_name via get_billing_name. Domestic: primary jpn AccountUserDetails.kanji_name else kana_name. Fallback on error: accounts get_addressee_name.
transformation: Interpolated straight into an f-string. No to_full_width and no honorific, unlike the billing statement postal customer name.

source: addresses_address structured street address physical_location_identifier on the supply point property
transformation: Passthrough; codes.UNSPECIFIED (' ') when the key is absent.

source: Hardcoded Japanese templates: the METI subsidy message inside its display window, otherwise the payment slip printing fee grace period notice (grace end date derived from billing_accountcharge and the supply point reading schedule). codes.UNSPECIFIED (' ') when neither applies.
transformation: Three columns concatenated with no separator. On a re-presentation of a card or direct debit payment an apology line becomes column 1 and the other columns shift down one.

source: Hardcoded Japanese string (no database origin)
transformation: Constant 'ガス料金等払込書送付のご案内' on every branch.

source: Hardcoded Japanese templates (no database origin)
transformation: Four columns concatenated. Populated only when the payment is a re-presentation of a card or direct debit payment; otherwise four codes.UNSPECIFIED spaces.

source: Hardcoded Japanese templates (no database origin)
transformation: Six columns concatenated. Populated only when the payment is a re-presentation of a card or direct debit payment; otherwise six codes.UNSPECIFIED spaces.

source: payments_accountpayment.amount
transformation: Emitted as an integer, no rounding.

source: Line items period end of the gas and electricity billing_accountcharge rows on the statement; when there are no energy charges, the latest billing_accountcharge.posting_date among ancillary charges
transformation: localtime.date_of_day_before(period.end); plus one further day when there is an electricity charge and no gas charge. str(date) gives YYYY-MM-DD.

source: market_jpn_gas_gasreading.reading_date when a gas supply point and reading exist, otherwise market_jpn_electricity_electricityintervalreading.end_at
transformation: BUG (item 22): reading_date_utc returns a UTC datetime (gas: JST midnight of the reading date converted to UTC; elec: end_at). strftime('%Y/%m/%d') is then applied to that UTC datetime with no conversion back to JST, so the emitted date is the day before the 検針日. Confirmed by the test snapshots: bill_context.meter_reading_date '2024/09/11' against a gas breakdown date of '09/12', and '2024/09/12' against an elec breakdown date of '09/13'. Empty string when the statement has no energy charges.

source: localtime.today() at context generation time (no database origin)
transformation: str(date) gives YYYY-MM-DD.

source: tokyogas_late_payment_interest_billpaymentrecord.bill_due_date, reconciled from the payment via the schedule trigger event and issuance_issuedbillingdocument
transformation: str(date) gives YYYY-MM-DD.

source: Dual fuel: market_jpn_gas_gassupplypoint.spin last 11 digits. Elec-only: TG external account details CUSTOMER_REGISTRATION_NUMBER reference, else the primary account user's registration number.
transformation: format_customer_registration_number inserts hyphens after positions 4 and 7 (1234-567-8901).

ja_label: ガスメーター社番（下3桁）
source: market_jpn_gas_gassupplypoint.physical_meter_number of the gas supply point behind the gas charge; for a dual fuel statement with no gas charge, the active or ending gas supply point at statement.finalized_at
transformation: physical_meter_number[-3:]; empty string when there is no meter number, and empty for elec-only customers.

source: Energy lines: 'ガス料金'/'電気料金' plus PRODUCT_NAME_ALIASES lookup on market_supply_product.code (gas may append the addon band). Other lines: the display of the matching TOKYOGAS charge or credit reason registry entry, falling back to billing_accountcharge.display_note. Reversals: an English 'Reversed charge (...)' string.
transformation: Late payment interest appends ' （YYYY年MM月DD日分請求）' when the source reading date can be reconciled, else falls back to AccountCharge.display. When more than BREAKDOWN_ITEM_COUNT=11 items exist, item 11 takes the 11th display plus '等'.

source: billing_accountcharge.gross_amount or billing_accountcredit.gross_amount
transformation: Integer, no rounding. Credits and reversals are negated to signal a credit to TG. Ancillary items are summed per reason. Item 11 carries the sum of all overflow items.

source: billing_accountcharge.sales_tax_amount or billing_accountcredit.sales_tax_amount (0 when null)
transformation: Integer. Not negated for credits, unlike gross_amount. Late payment interest is hardcoded to 0. In the overflow aggregate the sign is applied based on whether each item's gross_amount is negative.

source: Energy lines: the 検針日 from market_jpn_gas_gasreading.reading_date or market_jpn_electricity_electricityintervalreading.end_at. Other lines: billing_accountcharge.posting_date or billing_accountcredit.posting_date.
transformation: localtime.date(reading_date_utc(reading)) then strftime('%m/%d'), or '%Y/%m/%d' when feature flag PS_JSON_USE_YEAR_IN_BREAKDOWN_ITEM_DATE is on. Empty string on the overflow aggregate row.

source: number_of_units on the consumption line items of the energy billing_accountcharge, excluding fuel cost adjustment lines
transformation: Decimal sum then int() truncation, cast to str. Empty string for non-energy lines.

source: Hardcoded: literal 'm3' for gas, constants.KWH_CONSUMPTION_UNIT for electricity
transformation: Constant 'm3' or 'ｋＷｈ'. Empty string for non-energy lines.

source: Line items period of the energy billing_accountcharge
transformation: f'{start:%m/%d}～{end:%m/%d}' where start is localtime midnight of period.start and end is localtime midnight of period.end minus one day, because the line item period is exclusive of its end. Empty string for non-energy lines.

source: Meter reading slip printing fee line only: the reading date resolved at the top of generate(), which is market_jpn_gas_gasreading.reading_date for gas or market_jpn_electricity_electricityintervalreading.billable_at for electricity
transformation: strftime('%m/%d'). Empty string on every other line. The code carries an explicit instruction not to change this format without HUB's agreement, because HUB does further formatting off it.

source: Late payment interest lines only: the reading date of the original electricity or gas charge that produced the fee, reconciled through issuance_billingdocument
transformation: strftime('%Y/%m/%d'). Empty string when the source cannot be reconciled and on every other line type (attrs default '').

source: market_jpn_electricity_electricitysupplypoint and the supply details active at the line items period start
transformation: Display string such as '40A'. Only present on ElectricityBreakdownItem: when feature flag PS_JSON_INCLUDE_CONTRACTED_CAPACITY_FOR_ELEC_BREAKDOWN_ITEMS is off the plain BreakdownItem class is used and the key is absent from the JSON object entirely (not null).
